comment: The condition reads the x-ssl-protocol request header, which the suite's own fronting nginx sets in its standard deployment; the hermetic stack serves the suite over direct HTTPS with no proxy, so the header is absent. The OP's outbound TLS is rustls (TLS 1.3-capable); this is a harness artifact, not an OP property.
Same harness artifact as EnsureIncomingTls13 (the x-ssl-protocol header exists only behind the suite's nginx fronting proxy).
